sources.entry: Evidence - Code-based BI tool. Write reports using SQL and markdown and they render as a website. (Source Code) MIT Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Evidence is an open-source, code-based business intelligence tool for writing reports in SQL and markdown that render as a website.
summary.what_it_does: Evidence lets you build data reports by writing SQL queries and markdown in a project folder rather than using drag-and-drop dashboards. The README describes a CLI with commands such as `evidence init` to create a project, `evidence dev` to run it locally, and `evidence help` for usage. It supports developing with the built-in Agent or with local AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor. Finished projects can be published to Evidence Studio (hosted) or exported as a generated static site for self-hosting.
use_cases: create a BI dashboard as code
share analytics reports with a team
develop BI reports with an AI coding assistant
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | sh  (macOS / Linux installer; URL missing from README text)
Publish via Evidence Studio or self-host the generated static site
notable: Reports are plain code (SQL plus markdown), so they can be version controlled
Built-in Agent for development, or use local tools like Claude Code and Cursor
Output is a static site that can be self-hosted
Optional hosted publishing via Evidence Studio
caveats: Hosted publishing requires Evidence Studio, which the README presents as an option; pricing and tiers are not described
Install commands in the README are incomplete in the provided text (URLs are missing), so exact install steps cannot be confirmed here
Setup details for data sources and self-hosting are deferred to external docs
